name: planner-working
prompt: Create a TRUE FRAME-BY-FRAME CHARACTER ACTING sprite animation atlas of the EXACT referenced red panda. SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 sequential frames reading order. Each tile square, centered with 15 percent transparent margins. Transparent background, no grid or text. The animal must ARTICULATE its arms, paws, head, legs, ears and tail through changing poses, NOT stretch or translate a fixed drawing. Preserve exact reference face, ear size, body proportions, fur colors, costume, tail stripes, outline thickness throughout. Saturated orange fur, dark plum outline, cream cheeks, crisp pixel clusters. Pixel art designed at 128px, no soft painted texture or gradients. Camera fixed 3/4 front, feet baseline fixed except jump. Native silhouette size constant all frames. Smooth consecutive poses with strong readable key poses, anticipation and follow-through. No random changes of model. Glasses and teal scarf stay on. Clipboard and pencil. Frames1-4 lift clipboard from side to chest with left paw while right paw raises pencil.5-8 head bends down, right elbow bends and pencil touches paper.9-12 right paw draws a check stroke across clipboard, head follows.13-16 pencil lifts, face lifts, small satisfied nod.17-20 free pencil paw gives a little proud upward gesture.21-24 lower paw and clipboard toward starting pose. LARGE CYAN FOUR-POINTED STAR GLINTS over both eyeglasses, white centers, four long diamond rays, no circular dots. Star light follows the face. No floating check symbol or fireworks.
